Name: unit03:outline:0
JsonString: {"unit_id": "unit03", "point": "Introduction: state the thesis that reading books is important mainly for three reasons."}

Name: unit03:outline:1
JsonString: {"unit_id": "unit03", "point": "Cause 1: Reading broadens our knowledge and provides experience that we can hardly have in our own life."}

Name: unit03:outline:2
JsonString: {"unit_id": "unit03", "point": "Cause 2: Reading exercises our brains and improves our mental health."}

Name: unit03:outline:3
JsonString: {"unit_id": "unit03", "point": "Cause 3: Reading increases empathy and makes communication more efficient, so reading is indispensable and we should all form the habit of reading."}

Name: unit04:outline:0
JsonString: {"unit_id": "unit04", "point": "Introduction: state the thesis that deciding whether to continue your studies or go to work will have different and profound impacts on your future life and career."}

Name: unit04:outline:1
JsonString: {"unit_id": "unit04", "point": "Point 1: Your decision will influence the way you spend your time at college — continuing to study means more classes and campus life, while going to work replaces study time with office duties."}

Name: unit04:outline:2
JsonString: {"unit_id": "unit04", "point": "Point 2: Your decision has financial implications — continuing to study involves tuition costs and delayed earnings, whereas going to work brings in a salary at once."}

Name: unit04:outline:3
JsonString: {"unit_id": "unit04", "point": "Point 3: Your decision will have a great impact on your future job opportunities; conclude that you should be clear about these possible impacts before making the final decision."}

Name: unit05:outline:0
JsonString: {"unit_id": "unit05", "point": "Introduction: State the thesis that curiosity is the secret to scientific breakthroughs."}

Name: unit05:outline:1
JsonString: {"unit_id": "unit05", "point": "Body 1: Curiosity sparks questions that matter in scientific discovery - the example of Li Siguang and the Quaternary Glacial Theory of China."}

Name: unit05:outline:2
JsonString: {"unit_id": "unit05", "point": "Body 2: Curiosity gives people the persistence to keep looking for discoveries - the examples of Michael Faraday and Tu Youyou."}

Name: unit05:outline:3
JsonString: {"unit_id": "unit05", "point": "Conclusion: Curiosity plays a key role in important scientific breakthroughs."}
